ITEM 1 | Cubed pieces roughly 2-3 cm, golden-brown to deep tan with darker browned edges and crisp-looking crusty surfaces, some pieces with a slightly glossy oily sheen, dry-looking exterior, firm and holding shape, arranged in a loose mound in the upper right quadrant of a square white plate | 150
ITEM 2 | Small pale white dollop, roughly 1 cm, soft and creamy-looking with a slight sheen, sitting on top of the browned cubes near their center | 5
ITEM 3 | Wedges and chunks of bright red fruit, roughly 2-3 cm pieces with a moist, juicy surface and slight sheen, pale pinkish-white edge visible on some, arranged in a cluster at the lower right of the mound, sitting alongside the browned cubes | 130
